PURPOSE OF REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL (RFP)
This Request for Proposal (RFP) will be for student and staff computing devices, including laptops,
desktops, tablet devices, and display monitors. Vendors participating in this Request for Proposal (RFP) may
submit proposals for one, several, or all categories of devices required by the District. Within each category
of device, the District reserves the right to award contracts to a single vendor or multiple vendors.

Product Specification.value: Student devices: Screen resolution 1920-1080 non-touch; Memory 16GB DDR5; Wireless 802.11AX WiFi-6E and Bluetooth 5.1; Power supply Type C 65W; Battery life minimum 10 hours; Ports minimum 2 USB 3.0, 1 Type C, 65HDMI, 1 headphone/microphone combo; Storage 256GB NVMe SSD; OS Windows 11 Pro; Warranty 3-year minimum. Student tablet: Processor A13; Display 10.2" Retina; Camera 8MP wide; Screen resolution 2160x1620 multi-touch; Wireless 802.11AC and Bluetooth 4.2; Power supply included; Battery life minimum 10 hours; Ports 1 headphone; Storage 64GB; OS iOS 17; Warranty 1-year minimum. Staff devices: Tier 1 Staff: Chrome OS license required; Warranty 1-year minimum. Tier 3 Student Windows Laptop: Intel i5 13th Gen or equivalent; Display minimum 13" diagonal; Camera 720p minimum. Display monitors: Touch and Non-Touch: Minimum 24" diagonal; Resolution 1920x1080; Port USB 3.1 Hub; Aspect ratio 16:9; Contrast 3000:1; Warranty 3-year minimum.
